proof.verificationCase: binds every executable release surface to the package version

claims.blockedReason: The claim is what every consumer's first command reports, so it needs CONSENTED remote evidence: a published `mjolnir-qa@<version>` install observed from outside this checkout. No such observation exists and none can be manufactured from inside the tree that produced the tarball — that is what `scripts/revalidate-claims.mjs` §THE RULE calls self-derivation. The local half is verified continuously by the named verificationCase.

proof.verificationCase: every measured entry's revision matches the rule's declared revision (§20.5)

claims.expiry: on rule or detector revision change
claims.blockedReason: The census is generated FROM the verdict corpus, so the corpus cannot be the evidence that the census is right — every verdict it summarises is its own input. Promoting this needs a classifier that has never seen the verdicts it is scored against, which is a held-out split rather than a running command. The measured count is drift-locked by `tests/contract/census-drift.spec.ts` in the meantime.

proof.verificationCase: output carries the shipped structural markers

claims.blockedReason: The marker is a string both the reporter and the workflow emit, and both sides are in this tree. A consumer-side observation — a PR comment fetched back from the GitHub API on a repository that is not this one — is the only evidence that is not the claim restating itself. That needs a token and an external repository, neither of which belongs in a PR gate.

proof.verificationCase: keeps every evidence reference relative and present

claims.expiry: on model, data-flow, or boundary change
claims.blockedReason: The threat model is APPROVED for the working candidate but has not been reviewed by anyone outside it. An internal approval recorded in the same repository that produced the model is the shape of self-certification this registry exists to refuse, so the claim stays BLOCKED until an external reviewer is named. `docs/adr/0012-hosted-enterprise-boundary.md` records the boundary decision.
